easyLearnConcepts.title: Prove √5 or √3 is Irrational (3 Marks Sure-Shot)
easyLearnConcepts.analogy: நண்பனை துப்பறியும் முறை: முதலில் √5 விகிதமுறு எண் (p/q) என்று தப்பாக நினைத்துக்கொண்டு, கடைசியில் முரண்பாடு என்று நிரூபித்தல்.
simpleSteps: Step 1: Let √5 = a/b (where a and b are co-prime integers, b ≠ 0)
Step 2: Squaring both sides: 5 = a²/b²  ⟹  5b² = a²  (So 5 divides a² and a)
Step 3: Put a = 5c  ⟹  5b² = (5c)² = 25c²  ⟹  b² = 5c² (So 5 divides b² and b)
Step 4: This means 5 divides both a and b. Contradiction! Hence √5 is IRRATIONAL.
easyLearnConcepts.proTip: √2, √3, √5 எதை கேட்டாலும் 5 இருக்கும் இடத்தில் 3 அல்லது 2 என்று மாற்றினால் போதும்! 3 மதிப்பெண் கையில்!

easyLearnConcepts.subject: Mathematics
easyLearnConcepts.title: Quadratic Formula: Find x in 3 Easy Steps
easyLearnConcepts.analogy: காரணிப்படுத்தல் (Factorisation) கஷ்டமாக இருந்தால் யோசிக்கவே வேண்டாம். இந்த ஃபார்முலாவை போட்டால் எந்த கணக்கிற்கும் விடை வரும்!
simpleSteps: Step 1: Find a, b, c from ax² + bx + c = 0
Step 2: Calculate Discriminant: D = b² - 4ac
Step 3: Use Master Formula: x = (-b ± √D) / (2a)
Rule: If D > 0 (2 distinct answers), If D = 0 (same answer), If D < 0 (no real root)
easyLearnConcepts.proTip: Exam-ல் 'Formula Method' என்று எழுதினால் ஸ்டெப் மார்க் முழுமையாக கிடைக்கும்.

easyLearnConcepts.subject: Mathematics
easyLearnConcepts.title: Basic Proportionality Theorem (BPT / Thales)
easyLearnConcepts.analogy: ஒரு முக்கோணத்தின் ஒரு பக்கத்திற்கு இணையாக (Parallel) கோடு வரைந்தால், அது மற்ற இரண்டு பக்கங்களையும் சரிசமமான விகிதத்தில் பிரிக்கும்.
simpleSteps: Given: In △ABC, DE ∥ BC intersecting AB at D and AC at E.
To Prove: AD / DB = AE / EC
Construction: Join BE and CD. Draw DM ⊥ AC and EN ⊥ AB.
Proof: Ratio of Area(△ADE) / Area(△BDE) = AD / DB
Ratio of Area(△ADE) / Area(△CDE) = AE / EC. Triangles on same base DE have equal area. Hence proved!

easyLearnConcepts.subject: Science
easyLearnConcepts.title: 4 Types of Chemical Reactions in Simple Story
easyLearnConcepts.analogy:
1. சேர்க்கை: இருவர் சேர்ந்து நண்பராவது (A + B → AB)
2. சிதைவு: ஒருவர் பிரிந்து செல்வது (AB → A + B)
3. இடப்பெயர்ச்சி: பலசாலி வந்து பலவீனனை மாற்றுவது (Zn + CuSO4 → ZnSO4 + Cu)
4. இரட்டை இடப்பெயர்ச்சி: இருவரும் தோழர்களை மாற்றிக்கொள்வது (AgNO3 + NaCl → AgCl + NaNO3)
simpleSteps: Combination: CaO + H₂O → Ca(OH)₂ (Slaked lime + Heat)
Decomposition: 2FeSO₄ + Heat → Fe₂O₃ + SO₂ + SO₃
Displacement: Fe + CuSO₄ (Blue) → FeSO₄ (Green) + Cu (Brown)
Precipitation (White): Na₂SO₄ + BaCl₂ → BaSO₄ (White ppt) + 2NaCl
easyLearnConcepts.proTip: CuSO4 நீல நிறம் FeSO4 பச்சை நிறமாக மாறும் - இந்த நிற மாற்றம் அடிக்கடி கேட்கப்படும் கேள்வி!

easyLearnConcepts.subject: Science
easyLearnConcepts.title: Ohm's Law: The Water Pipe Secret
easyLearnConcepts.analogy:
குழாயில் பாயும் தண்ணீர் = Current (I)
தண்ணீரின் பிரஷர்/அழுத்தம் = Voltage (V)
குழாயின் அடைப்பு/தடை = Resistance (R)
அழுத்தம் அதிகமானால் தண்ணீர் அதிகம் பாயும்: V = I × R
simpleSteps: Statement: Current (I) passing through a conductor is directly proportional to Potential Difference (V) across its ends at constant temperature.
Formula: V = I × R   (R = V / I)
SI Unit of Resistance = Ohm (Ω)
Factors affecting R: R ∝ Length (L), R ∝ 1 / Area (A)  ⟹  R = ρ(L / A)
easyLearnConcepts.proTip: கம்பியின் நீளம் இரட்டிப்பானால் Resistance இரட்டிப்பாகும். தடிமன் அதிகமானால் Resistance குறையும்!

sampleQuestions.q: If $\alpha, \beta$ are zeroes of $x^2 - p(x+1) - c$, show that $(\alpha+1)(\beta+1) = 1-c$.
sampleQuestions.a: $x^2 - px - (p+c) = 0$. $\alpha+\beta = p, \alpha\beta = -(p+c)$. $(\alpha+1)(\beta+1) = \alpha\beta + \alpha + \beta + 1 = -(p+c) + p + 1 = 1 - c$.

sampleQuestions.a: During digestion, food is broken down into glucose. Glucose combines with oxygen in cells releasing ATP energy: $C_6H_{12}O_6 + 6O_2 \rightarrow 6CO_2 + 6H_2O + \text{Energy}$.

sampleQuestions.q: Identify the substance oxidized and reduced in: $CuO + H_2 \rightarrow Cu + H_2O$.

topicExplanations.subject: Mathematics
topicExplanations.topic: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic & Irrational Numbers
topicExplanations.tanglishExplanation:
Real numbers-ல ரெண்டே முக்கியமான concept தான் இருக்கு. முதல் விஷயம்: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic. எந்த ஒரு composite number-ஐயும் prime numbers-ஓட product-ஆ unique-ஆ எழுத முடியும். Example: 12-ஐ 2² × 3 என்று பிரிக்கலாம்.

ரெண்டாவது முக்கியமான 3-mark question: Prove √5 is irrational. இதை நிரூபிக்க 'Proof by Contradiction' method பயன்படுத்தணும். முதல்ல √5 = a/b (a, b co-prime) என்று assume பண்ணிட்டு, இரண்டு பக்கமும் square பண்ணா 5b² = a² வரும். அப்படின்னா 5 divides a. அடுத்து a = 5c என்று substitute பண்ணா, 5 divides b-யும் வரும். Co-prime-ஆ இருக்கிற ரெண்டு நம்பருக்கும் பொதுவான factor 5 வர முடியாது. So, our assumption is WRONG. Hence √5 is irrational!
englishExamTerms: Composite numbers expressed as product of primes
Contradiction arises because of incorrect assumption

topicExplanations.subject: Mathematics
topicExplanations.tanglishExplanation:
Quadratic equation standard form: ax² + bx + c = 0. Factorisation பண்ண கஷ்டமா இருந்தா, யோசிக்காம Quadratic Formula-வை போடுங்க:
x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / (2a).

இதுல b² - 4ac-க்கு பேரு தான் 'Discriminant' (D). இந்த D-யை வச்சு Roots-ஓட தன்மையை (Nature of Roots) 1-mark மற்றும் 3-mark-ல கேட்பாங்க:
Case 1: D > 0 (Positive) வந்தால், two distinct real roots (ரெண்டு வெவ்வேறு உண்மையான விடைகள் கிடைக்கும்).
Case 2: D = 0 வந்தால், two equal real roots (ரெண்டு சமமான விடைகள் கிடைக்கும்: x = -b / 2a).
Case 3: D < 0 (Negative) வந்தால், no real roots (மெய்மூலம் கிடையாது).

topicExplanations.subject: Mathematics

நிரூபிக்கும் முறை:
△ABC-ல DE ∥ BC. நாம நிரூபிக்க வேண்டியது AD / DB = AE / EC.
BE மற்றும் CD-யை join பண்ணுங்க. Altitude EN மற்றும் DM வரைங்க.
Area of triangle formula = 1/2 × base × height.
Area(△ADE) / Area(△BDE) = AD / DB (ஏன்னா height EN பொதுவானது).
அதேபோல Area(△ADE) / Area(△CDE) = AE / EC.
ஒரே base DE-ல இருக்கிற இரண்டு முக்கோணங்களின் Area சமம்! அதனால் AD / DB = AE / EC. ஹென்ஸ் ப்ரூவ்ட்!

topicExplanations.subject: Science
topicExplanations.tanglishExplanation:
Chemical equation-ஐ ஏன் balance பண்ணனும்? Law of Conservation of Mass-படி mass create-ம் ஆகாது destroy-ம் ஆகாது. So, Reactants side-ல இருக்கிற ஒவ்வொரு element-ன் atoms count-ம், Products side-ல இருக்கிற atoms count-ம் strictly equal-ஆ இருக்கணும்!

4 முக்கிய Reaction Types:
1. Combination: ரெண்டு அல்லது மூணு சேர்ந்து ஒரே ஒரு product உருவாகும் (A + B → AB). சுட்ட சுண்ணாம்பு CaO + H₂O → Ca(OH)₂ + Heat (Exothermic reaction).
2. Decomposition: ஒரு compound வெப்பம் பட்டு ரெண்டா உடையும். FeSO₄ (Green) சூடுபடுத்தினா Fe₂O₃ (Reddish brown) + SO₂ + SO₃ ஆகும்.
3. Displacement: More reactive element வந்து less reactive element-ஐ விரட்டும். Iron nail-ஐ Copper sulphate solution (Blue)-ல போட்டா, FeSO₄ (Green) உருவாகி copper படிந்திடும்!
4. Double Displacement: Ions exchange ஆகும். BaCl₂ + Na₂SO₄ → BaSO₄ (White precipitate) + 2NaCl.

topicExplanations.subject: Science
topicExplanations.topic: Ohm's Law, Resistance in Series and Parallel
topicExplanations.tanglishExplanation:
Electricity-ஐ ரொம்ப சுலபமா புரிஞ்சுக்கலாம்: Wire-ல் flow ஆகுற electron-களுக்கு பேரு தான் Electric Current (I), Unit = Ampere. தண்ணி வேகமா பாயுற அழுத்தம் தான் Potential Difference அல்லது Voltage (V), Unit = Volt. கரண்ட் போறதை தடுக்கிற தடை தான் Resistance (R), Unit = Ohm (Ω).

Ohm's Law: Temperature மாறாம இருக்கும்போது, Potential Difference (V) is directly proportional to Current (I). Formula: V = I × R.

Resistors Connection:
1. Series (ஒன்றன்பின் ஒன்றாக): Current (I) ஒரே அளவா இருக்கும். Total Resistance: Rs = R₁ + R₂ + R₃.
2. Parallel (பக்கவாட்டில்): Voltage (V) ஒரே அளவா இருக்கும். 1/Rp = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂ + 1/R₃. நம்ம வீட்டு domestic circuit-ல parallel தான் பயன்படுத்துவோம்!
englishExamTerms: Resistors in Series: Rs = R1 + R2 + R3
Joule's Law of Heating: H = I²Rt

writtenTasks.title: Maths: Prove √5 is Irrational in Notebook
writtenTasks.subject: Mathematics
writtenTasks.instructions: Rough note-ல் Proof by Contradiction முறையைப் பயன்படுத்தி √5 is irrational என ஸ்டெப்-பை-ஸ்டெப்பாக எழுதி போட்டோ அப்லோட் செய்.
writtenTasks.sampleNotebookText:
Let √5 = a/b where a,b are co-prime integers (b ≠ 0).
Squaring: 5b² = a² => 5 divides a² => 5 divides a.
Let a = 5c => 5b² = 25c² => b² = 5c² => 5 divides b.
Hence 5 is common factor of a and b. Contradiction! √5 is irrational.
writtenTasks.mamaFeedback: ரொம்ப நல்ல முயற்சி பிரணவ்! ஸ்டெப்ஸ் எல்லாம் கரெக்ட். கடைசியில Hence √5 is irrational என்று box போட்டா முழு 5 மார்க் கிடைக்கும்!
writtenTasks.textbookReference: NCERT Class 10 Mathematics Chapter 1 (Real Numbers), Theorem 1.3 & Theorem 1.4 (Pages 12-14)

keySteps: Assumption: Let √5 be a rational number, so √5 = a/b, where a and b are co-prime integers and b ≠ 0.
Squaring: Squaring both sides gives 5 = a²/b², which implies 5b² = a².
Divisibility 1: 5 divides a², therefore by NCERT Theorem 1.3, 5 divides a.
Substitution: Let a = 5c for some integer c. Substituting gives 5b² = 25c², so b² = 5c².
Divisibility 2: 5 divides b², therefore by Theorem 1.3, 5 divides b.
Contradiction: 5 is a common factor of both a and b. This contradicts that a and b are co-prime.
Conclusion: Hence, our initial assumption was wrong; √5 is an irrational number.
commonMistakes: NCERT பக்கம் 12-ல் உள்ளபடி Theorem 1.3 தியரத்தின் பெயரை (p divides a² => p divides a) மென்ஷன் பண்ணனும்.

writtenTasks.title: Science: State Ohm's Law, Formula & V-I Graph in Notebook
writtenTasks.subject: Science
writtenTasks.instructions: Ohm-ன் விதியை எழுதி, V = IR சமன்பாட்டை விளக்கி, V-I நேர்கோட்டு வரைபடத்தை (Graph) வரைந்து நோட்டைப் படம் பிடித்து அனுப்பு.
writtenTasks.textbookReference: NCERT Class 10 Science Chapter 11 (Electricity), Section 11.4 Ohm's Law (Pages 200-204)

keySteps: Statement: The potential difference (V) across the ends of a given metallic wire in an electric circuit is directly proportional to the current (I) flowing through it, provided its temperature remains the same.
Mathematical Formula: V ∝ I => V = IR, where R is resistance of conductor (unit: Ohm Ω).
V-I Graph: A straight line passing through the origin, indicating constant resistance (Slope = R = V/I).
essentialKeywords: straight line graph passing through origin
commonMistakes: ‘at constant temperature’ என்பதை எழுத மறந்துவிடக் கூடாது.

writtenTasks.title: Maths: Solve 2x² - 5x + 3 = 0 using Quadratic Formula
writtenTasks.subject: Mathematics
writtenTasks.instructions: Quadratic Formula x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / (2a) பயன்படுத்தி Discriminant D கணக்கிட்டு மூலங்களைக் கண்டுபிடி.
writtenTasks.textbookReference: NCERT Class 10 Mathematics Chapter 4, Section 4.4 Nature of Roots (Pages 87-91)

keySteps: Standard form comparison: ax² + bx + c = 0 => a = 2, b = -5, c = 3.
Nature of roots: Since D > 0, the equation has two distinct real roots.
commonMistakes: b = -5 என்பதால் -(-5) = +5 என கவனமாக எழுத வேண்டும்.

pranavDoubts.subject: Science
pranavDoubts.studentQuestion: What happens at anode and cathode in Chlor-alkali process?
pranavDoubts.tanglishAnswer:
ரொம்ப சிம்பிளா புரிஞ்சுக்கலாம் பிரணவ்!

📌 கேள்வி: "What happens at anode and cathode in Chlor-alkali process?"
Chlor-alkali process: உப்பு நீரை (Brine = NaCl + H₂O) மின்னாற்பகுப்பு (Electrolysis) செய்யும்போது 3 முக்கியமான பொருட்கள் கிடைக்கின்றன:
1. Chlorine (Cl₂) -> Anode (+ve) வழியே வெளியேறும்.
2. Hydrogen (H₂) -> Cathode (-ve) வழியே வெளியேறும்.
3. Sodium Hydroxide (NaOH) -> Solution-ல் தங்கும். சோப்பு தயாரிக்க உதவும்.

questions.question: An object 4 cm in height is placed at 15 cm in front of a concave mirror of focal length 10 cm. At what distance from the mirror should a screen be placed to obtain a sharp image? Calculate the height and nature of the image. Also draw the corresponding ray diagram. (5 Marks)
questions.answer:
Given: h_o = +4 cm, u = -15 cm, f = -10 cm.
Mirror formula: 1/v + 1/u = 1/f ⇒ 1/v = 1/(-10) - 1/(-15) = -1/10 + 1/15 = (-3 + 2)/30 = -1/30 ⇒ v = -30 cm.
Magnification: m = -v/u = -(-30)/(-15) = -2.
Image height: h_i = m × h_o = -2 × 4 = -8 cm.
Nature: Real, inverted, and magnified (beyond C).
questions.rubric: Given & sign convention: 1M, v = -30 cm calculation: 1.5M, h_i = -8 cm & nature: 1M, Ray diagram (object between F and C, image beyond C): 1.5M.

tamilSection.summary: Q4: Prove √3 is irrational & show 3 + 2√5 is irrational (5M) | Q5: Find k for equal roots in quadratic equation & solve roots (5M) | Q6: Train speed word problem using quadratic equations (5M)

questions.question:
(a) Prove that √3 is an irrational number. (3 Marks)
(b) Using the above result, prove that 5 - 2√3 is an irrational number. (2 Marks)
questions.answer:
(a) Assume √3 = a/b where a, b are coprime integers (b ≠ 0). Squaring: 3b² = a² ⇒ 3 divides a² ⇒ 3 divides a. Let a = 3c ⇒ 3b² = 9c² ⇒ b² = 3c² ⇒ 3 divides b² ⇒ 3 divides b. This contradicts that a and b are coprime. Hence √3 is irrational.
(b) Assume 5 - 2√3 = p/q (rational) ⇒ 2√3 = 5 - p/q = (5q - p)/q ⇒ √3 = (5q - p)/(2q), which is rational. Contradiction since √3 is irrational.
questions.rubric: Part (a) full contradiction steps: 3M; Part (b) rational rearrangement & contradiction statement: 2M.

questions.question: Find the values of k for which the quadratic equation (k + 4)x² + (k + 1)x + 1 = 0 has real and equal roots. Also find the roots of the equation for the obtained values of k. (5 Marks)
questions.rubric: D = 0 setup: 1M, Quadratic in k & solving k = 5, -3: 2M, Finding equal roots for both values of k: 2M.

questions.question: A train travels a distance of 360 km at a uniform speed. If the speed had been 5 km/h more, it would have taken 1 hour less for the same journey. Find the original speed of the train. (5 Marks)
questions.answer:
Let original speed of the train be x km/h.
Time taken = 360/x hours. New speed = (x + 5) km/h, New time = 360/(x + 5) hours.
According to question: 360/x - 360/(x + 5) = 1
360(x + 5 - x) = x(x + 5) ⇒ 1800 = x² + 5x ⇒ x² + 5x - 1800 = 0
(x + 45)(x - 40) = 0 ⇒ x = 40 (since speed cannot be negative).
Original speed of the train = 40 km/h.
questions.rubric: Equation formulation: 2M, Simplifying to x² + 5x - 1800 = 0: 1.5M, Solving & final speed with unit (40 km/h): 1.5M.

questions.question: Find the ratio in which the y-axis divides the line segment joining the points (5, -6) and (-1, -4). Also find the coordinates of the point of intersection. (5 Marks)

questions.question: State the factors on which the resistance of a cylindrical conductor depends. A wire of resistance 8 Ω is doubled on itself (folded in half). Calculate the new resistance of the wire. (5 Marks)
questions.answer:
Resistance depends on: (1) Length (R ∝ L), (2) Area of cross-section (R ∝ 1/A), (3) Nature of material (ρ), (4) Temperature.
When doubled on itself: New length L' = L/2, New area A' = 2A.
New Resistance R' = ρ(L/2) / (2A) = (1/4) × (ρL/A) = R / 4 = 8 / 4 = 2 Ω.

questions.question: State Joule's Law of Heating. An electric heater rated 1500 W operates 4 hours/day, and 4 LED bulbs rated 25 W each operate 6 hours/day. Calculate the total cost of electrical energy consumed in the month of November (30 days) at ₹6 per unit (kWh). (5 Marks)

Daily energy of heater = 1.5 kW × 4 h = 6 kWh.
Daily energy of 4 bulbs = (4 × 25)/1000 kW × 6 h = 0.1 kW × 6 h = 0.6 kWh.
Total daily energy = 6.6 kWh.
30 days energy = 6.6 × 30 = 198 kWh (units).

questions.question:
Prove the following trigonometric identities:
(a) √[(1 + sin A) / (1 - sin A)] = sec A + tan A (3 Marks)
(b) (sin A + cosec A)² + (cos A + sec A)² = 7 + tan² A + cot² A (2 Marks)
questions.answer:
(a) Multiply numerator and denominator inside square root by (1 + sin A): √[(1 + sin A)² / (1 - sin² A)] = √[(1 + sin A)² / cos² A] = (1 + sin A) / cos A = 1/cos A + sin A/cos A = sec A + tan A = RHS.
(b) Expand squares: sin²A + cosec²A + 2 + cos²A + sec²A + 2 = 1 + 4 + (1 + cot²A) + (1 + tan²A) = 7 + tan²A + cot²A.

questions.question: Prove that the lengths of tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are equal. (5 Marks)
questions.answer:
Given: Circle with centre O, external point P, tangents PQ and PR.
To Prove: PQ = PR.
Construction: Join OP, OQ, OR.
Proof: In right triangles ΔOQP and ΔORP:
1. ∠OQP = ∠ORP = 90° (Radius is perpendicular to tangent at point of contact)
2. OQ = OR (Radii of the same circle)
3. OP = OP (Common hypotenuse)
By RHS congruence criterion, ΔOQP ≅ ΔORP ⇒ PQ = PR (by CPCT).
questions.rubric: Diagram, Given, To Prove, Construction: 2M; RHS Congruence proof steps: 3M.

questions.question: A quadrilateral ABCD is drawn to circumscribe a circle. Prove that AB + CD = AD + BC. Hence show that a parallelogram circumscribing a circle is a rhombus. (5 Marks)
questions.answer:
Let the circle touch sides AB, BC, CD, DA at P, Q, R, S respectively.
Using tangents from external points: AP = AS, BP = BQ, CR = CQ, DR = DS.
Adding all four: (AP + BP) + (CR + DR) = (AS + DS) + (BQ + CQ) ⇒ AB + CD = AD + BC.
For a parallelogram, AB = CD and AD = BC ⇒ 2AB = 2BC ⇒ AB = BC. Thus all 4 sides are equal, so ABCD is a rhombus.

questions.question:
(a) Show the formation of Magnesium Chloride (MgCl₂) by the transfer of electrons using electron-dot structures. (2.5 Marks)
(b) Why do ionic compounds have high melting points and conduct electricity only in molten or aqueous state, not in solid state? (2.5 Marks)
questions.answer:
(a) Mg (2,8,2) loses 2 electrons to form Mg²⁺; two Cl atoms (2,8,7) each gain 1 electron to form 2Cl⁻.
(b) High melting point due to strong electrostatic forces of attraction between opposite ions. In solid state, ions are held in fixed positions; in molten/aqueous state, ions become free to move and conduct electricity.
questions.rubric: Electron-dot transfer diagram: 2.5M; Two scientific reasons: 2.5M.

questions.question: Differentiate between Roasting and Calcination with one balanced chemical equation each. Explain the electrolytic refining of copper with a labeled diagram. (5 Marks)
questions.answer:
Roasting: Heating sulphide ore strongly in presence of excess air (2ZnS + 3O₂ → 2ZnO + 2SO₂).
Calcination: Heating carbonate ore strongly in limited/absence of air (ZnCO₃ → ZnO + CO₂).
Electrolytic refining: Anode = Impure copper, Cathode = Thin strip of pure copper, Electrolyte = Acidified CuSO₄ solution. Pure copper deposits on cathode, impurities settle as anode mud.
questions.rubric: Roasting vs Calcination with equations: 2.5M; Electrolytic refining setup & diagram: 2.5M.

questions.question: Draw a neat labeled diagram of the longitudinal section (L.S.) of a bisexual flower. What happens to the ovule and ovary after fertilization? Mention any two categories of contraceptive methods. (5 Marks)
questions.answer:
Labeled diagram showing Stigma, Style, Ovary, Anther, Filament, Petal, Sepal.
After fertilization: Ovule develops into a tough-coated seed; Ovary grows rapidly and ripens to form a fruit.
Contraceptive methods: (1) Mechanical barrier (Condoms), (2) Chemical/Oral pills, (3) Surgical (Vasectomy/Tubectomy).
questions.rubric: Flower L.S. diagram: 2.5M; Ovule & ovary post-fertilization fate: 1.5M; Contraceptive methods: 1M.

questions.question: State any three key features of Federalism. Describe the major steps taken towards decentralisation in India through the Constitutional Amendment of 1992. (5 Marks)
questions.answer:
Features: Two or more levels of govt, distinct jurisdictions (Union, State, Concurrent lists), constitutional guarantee.
1992 Amendment steps:
1. Constitutionally mandatory to hold regular elections to local government bodies.
2. Seats reserved for SCs, STs, and OBCs.
3. At least one-third (1/3) of all positions reserved for women.
4. State Election Commission created to conduct panchayat and municipal elections.
questions.rubric: Features: 2M; 1992 Decentralisation provisions: 3M.

questions.question:
(a) Distinguish between Alluvial Soil and Black Soil (Regur Soil) on the basis of formation, distribution, and crops grown. (3 Marks)
(b) How is rainwater harvesting carried out in the semi-arid regions of Rajasthan ('Tankas')? (2 Marks)
questions.answer:
(a) Alluvial: Deposited by Himalayan rivers (Indus, Ganga, Brahmaputra), covers Northern Plains, rich in potash/phosphoric acid, ideal for paddy, wheat, sugarcane. Black Soil: Formed by weathering of Deccan lava flows (basalt), covers Maharashtra/Gujarat, high moisture retention, ideal for cotton.
(b) Underground tanks ('Tankas') built inside main house/courtyard connected to sloping roofs via pipes to store purest 'Palar Pani' drinking water.

questions.question: Why is the Tertiary Sector becoming so important in India? How can more employment be created in rural and semi-rural areas (including MGNREGA 2005)? (5 Marks)

Employment creation: Cheap agricultural credit, dams/canals irrigation, agro-processing industries in villages, and MGNREGA 2005 (guarantees 100 days of wage employment per year to rural households).

questions.question: A toy is in the form of a cone of radius 3.5 cm mounted on a hemisphere of the same radius. The total height of the toy is 15.5 cm. Find the total surface area and volume of the toy. (5 Marks)

questions.question: A solid wooden article was made by scooping out a hemisphere from each end of a solid cylinder. If the height of the cylinder is 10 cm and its base is of radius 3.5 cm, find the total surface area of the article. (5 Marks)
questions.answer:
Given: r = 3.5 cm, h = 10 cm.
TSA of article = CSA of cylinder + 2 × CSA of hemisphere
= 2πrh + 2(2πr²) = 2πr(h + 2r)
= 2 × (22/7) × 3.5 × (10 + 2 × 3.5)
= 22 × (10 + 7) = 22 × 17 = 374 cm².
questions.rubric: Formula 2πrh + 4πr²: 2M, Substitution: 1.5M, Final answer 374 cm²: 1.5M.

questions.question: A vessel is in the form of an inverted cone. Its height is 8 cm and the radius of its top, which is open, is 5 cm. It is filled with water up to the brim. When lead shots, each of which is a sphere of radius 0.5 cm, are dropped into the vessel, one-fourth of the water flows out. Find the number of lead shots dropped in the vessel. (5 Marks)
questions.answer:
Volume of water in cone V_cone = (1/3)πR²H = (1/3)π(5²)(8) = (200/3)π cm³.
Volume of water overflowed = (1/4) × (200/3)π = (50/3)π cm³.
Volume of 1 spherical lead shot V_shot = (4/3)πr³ = (4/3)π(0.5)³ = (4/3)π(1/8) = (1/6)π cm³.
Number of lead shots n = Volume overflowed / V_shot = [(50/3)π] / [(1/6)π] = (50/3) × 6 = 100 lead shots.
questions.rubric: Cone volume & 1/4 overflow: 2M, Lead shot volume: 1.5M, n = 100 shots: 1.5M.

questions.question: Explain the Chlor-Alkali process with a balanced chemical equation. How are (i) Bleaching Powder and (ii) Plaster of Paris prepared? Write balanced chemical equations and state one use of each. (5 Marks)
questions.answer:

(i) Bleaching Powder: Ca(OH)₂ + Cl₂ → CaOCl₂ + H₂O (Disinfecting water).
(ii) Plaster of Paris: CaSO₄·2H₂O —(373 K)→ CaSO₄·½H₂O + 1½H₂O (Setting fractured bones).

(b) Why cannot sodium and magnesium be reduced from their oxides using carbon? How are they extracted? (2.5 Marks)
questions.answer:
(a) Reaction of Iron(III) oxide with aluminium powder: Fe₂O₃(s) + 2Al(s) → 2Fe(l) + Al₂O₃(s) + Heat. Used to join railway tracks or cracked machine parts.
(b) These metals have more affinity for oxygen than carbon. They are extracted by Electrolytic Reduction of their molten chlorides (NaCl, MgCl₂).

questions.answer:
(a) Family of organic compounds having the same functional group where successive members differ by a -CH₂ unit (14 u mass). Characteristics: Similar chemical properties, gradation in physical properties.
(b) Dehydration occurs forming ethene: CH₃CH₂OH —(Hot Conc. H₂SO₄, 443 K)→ CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O. Conc. H₂SO₄ acts as a dehydrating agent.

questions.question: The sum of a two-digit number and the number obtained by reversing the digits is 66. If the digits of the number differ by 2, find the number. How many such numbers are there? (5 Marks)
questions.answer:
Let tens digit = x, units digit = y. Number = 10x + y, Reversed = 10y + x.
(10x + y) + (10y + x) = 66 ⇒ 11(x + y) = 66 ⇒ x + y = 6 ...(1)
Case 1: x - y = 2 ...(2) ⇒ Adding gives 2x = 8 ⇒ x = 4, y = 2 ⇒ Number = 42.
Case 2: y - x = 2 ...(3) ⇒ Adding gives 2y = 8 ⇒ y = 4, x = 2 ⇒ Number = 24.
There are two such numbers: 42 and 24.
questions.rubric: Equation x + y = 6: 2M; Case 1 (42): 1.5M; Case 2 (24): 1.5M.

questions.question: If the sum of the first n terms of an AP is given by S_n = 4n - n², what is the first term, the sum of first two terms, the second term, and the 10th term? Also find the nth term. (5 Marks)
questions.answer:
First term a₁ = S₁ = 4(1) - 1² = 3.
Sum of first two terms S₂ = 4(2) - 2² = 8 - 4 = 4.
Second term a₂ = S₂ - S₁ = 4 - 3 = 1.
Common difference d = a₂ - a₁ = 1 - 3 = -2.
10th term a₁₀ = a + 9d = 3 + 9(-2) = -15.
nth term a_n = a + (n - 1)d = 3 + (n - 1)(-2) = 5 - 2n.

questions.question: State and prove the Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales Theorem): If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle to intersect the other two sides in distinct points, the other two sides are divided in the same ratio. (5 Marks)
questions.answer:
Statement: 1M. Given: In ΔABC, DE ∥ BC. To Prove: AD/DB = AE/EC. Construction: Join BE and CD; draw DM ⊥ AC and EN ⊥ AB.
Proof: ar(ΔADE)/ar(ΔBDE) = (½ × AD × EN)/(½ × DB × EN) = AD/DB.
ar(ΔADE)/ar(ΔCDE) = (½ × AE × DM)/(½ × EC × DM) = AE/EC.
Since ΔBDE and ΔCDE are on the same base DE and between same parallels DE and BC, ar(ΔBDE) = ar(ΔCDE).
Therefore, AD/DB = AE/EC.
questions.rubric: Statement: 1M; Diagram, Given, To Prove, Construction: 1.5M; Area ratio proof: 2.5M.

questions.question: From a point on a bridge across a river, the angles of depression of the banks on opposite sides of the river are 30° and 45°, respectively. If the bridge is at a height of 3 m from the banks, find the width of the river. (5 Marks)
questions.answer:
Height of bridge h = 3 m. Let distances of the two banks be x and y.
In first right triangle: tan 30° = 3/x ⇒ 1/√3 = 3/x ⇒ x = 3√3 m.
In second right triangle: tan 45° = 3/y ⇒ 1 = 3/y ⇒ y = 3 m.
Total width of river = x + y = 3√3 + 3 = 3(√3 + 1) m [or 3 × 2.732 = 8.196 m].
questions.rubric: Diagram with angles of depression: 1.5M; x = 3√3 m & y = 3 m: 2M; Total width 3(√3 + 1) m: 1.5M.

questions.question: Two tangents TP and TQ are drawn to a circle with centre O from an external point T. Prove that ∠PTQ = 2∠OPQ. (5 Marks)
questions.answer:
Let ∠PTQ = θ. Since TP = TQ (tangents from external point), ΔTPQ is isosceles with ∠TPQ = ∠TQP = (180° - θ)/2 = 90° - θ/2.
Also, ∠OPT = 90° (radius ⊥ tangent).
Therefore, ∠OPQ = ∠OPT - ∠TPQ = 90° - (90° - θ/2) = θ/2 = ½∠PTQ.
Hence, ∠PTQ = 2∠OPQ.
questions.rubric: Diagram: 1M; Isosceles ΔTPQ angle 90° - θ/2: 2M; Using ∠OPT = 90° to prove ∠PTQ = 2∠OPQ: 2M.

questions.question:
(a) Two dice are thrown at the same time. Find the probability of getting: (i) a doublet, (ii) a sum of 8, (iii) a product less than 9. (3 Marks)
(b) From a well-shuffled deck of 52 cards, all kings, queens, and jacks of clubs are removed. One card is drawn at random. Find the probability of getting a face card. (2 Marks)
questions.answer:
(a) Total outcomes = 36.
(i) Doublet: (1,1)...(6,6) = 6/36 = 1/6.
(ii) Sum of 8: (2,6),(3,5),(4,4),(5,3),(6,2) = 5/36.
(iii) Product < 9: 16/36 = 4/9.
(b) Remaining cards = 52 - 3 = 49. Remaining face cards = 12 - 3 = 9. Probability = 9/49.
questions.rubric: Part (a) 3 × 1M = 3M; Part (b) 9/49: 2M.

3. Legitimate: A democratic government is people's own government elected by majority mandate, enjoying overwhelming global support.

questions.question:
(a) An organic compound 'A' (molecular formula C₂H₄O₂) reacts with ethanol in the presence of conc. H₂SO₄ to form a sweet-smelling compound 'B'. Identify 'A' and 'B', and write the chemical equation. How can 'A' be obtained back from 'B'? (3 Marks)

questions.answer:
(a) A = Ethanoic acid (CH₃COOH), B = Ethyl ethanoate (CH₃COOC₂H₅).
CH₃COOH + C₂H₅OH —(Conc. H₂SO₄)→ CH₃COOC₂H₅ + H₂O.
On treating 'B' with NaOH (Saponification) followed by acidification, 'A' is obtained back.

questions.question: An object of height 5 cm is placed perpendicular to the principal axis of a concave lens of focal length 10 cm at a distance of 20 cm from it. Find the position, nature, and size of the image. Also state why the sun appears reddish early in the morning or at sunset. (5 Marks)
questions.answer:
Concave lens: f = -10 cm, u = -20 cm, h_o = +5 cm.
1/v - 1/u = 1/f ⇒ 1/v = 1/(-10) + 1/(-20) = -3/20 ⇒ v = -20/3 = -6.67 cm.
m = v/u = (-20/3)/(-20) = +1/3 ⇒ h_i = 5/3 = +1.67 cm (Virtual, erect, diminished).
At sunrise/sunset, light travels a longer distance through the atmosphere; shorter blue wavelengths scatter away, while longer red wavelengths reach our eyes.
questions.rubric: v = -6.67 cm & h_i = +1.67 cm: 3.5M; Atmospheric scattering explanation: 1.5M.

questions.question:
(a) If sin θ + cos θ = √3, then prove that tan θ + cot θ = 1. (3 Marks)
(b) Find the 20th term from the last term of the AP: 3, 8, 13, ..., 253. (2 Marks)
questions.answer:
(a) Squaring sin θ + cos θ = √3: sin²θ + cos²θ + 2 sin θ cos θ = 3 ⇒ 1 + 2 sin θ cos θ = 3 ⇒ sin θ cos θ = 1.
Now tan θ + cot θ = sin θ/cos θ + cos θ/sin θ = (sin²θ + cos²θ)/(sin θ cos θ) = 1 / 1 = 1.
(b) Reversing AP: a = 253, d = -5. a₂₀ = 253 + 19(-5) = 253 - 95 = 158.
questions.rubric: Part (a) 3M; Part (b) 158: 2M.

questions.question: In figure, XY and X'Y' are two parallel tangents to a circle with centre O and another tangent AB with point of contact C intersecting XY at A and X'Y' at B. Prove that ∠AOB = 90°. (5 Marks)
questions.answer:
Join OC. In ΔOPA and ΔOCA: OP = OC (radii), AP = AC (tangents from A), OA = OA (common) ⇒ ΔOPA ≅ ΔOCA (SSS) ⇒ ∠POA = ∠COA.
Similarly, ΔOQB ≅ ΔOCB ⇒ ∠QOB = ∠COB.
Since PQ is a diameter (straight line), ∠POA + ∠COA + ∠COB + ∠QOB = 180° ⇒ 2(∠COA + ∠COB) = 180° ⇒ ∠AOB = 90°.
questions.rubric: Diagram & construction: 1.5M; Congruence ΔOPA ≅ ΔOCA: 1.5M; Angle sum 2∠AOB = 180° ⇒ ∠AOB = 90°: 2M.

questions.question: A metallic sphere of radius 4.2 cm is melted and recast into the shape of a cylinder of radius 6 cm. Find the height of the cylinder. Also, if the mean of 5 observations x, x+2, x+4, x+6, and x+8 is 11, find the value of x and the mode/median relationship (Empirical Formula). (5 Marks)
questions.answer:
Volume of cylinder = Volume of sphere ⇒ πR²H = (4/3)πr³ ⇒ 6 × 6 × H = (4/3) × 4.2 × 4.2 × 4.2 ⇒ H = 2.744 cm.
Mean = (5x + 20)/5 = x + 4 = 11 ⇒ x = 7.
Empirical Formula: 3 Median = Mode + 2 Mean.
questions.rubric: H = 2.744 cm: 3M; x = 7 & Empirical Formula: 2M.

modelQA.subject: Science
modelQA.question: A compound 'X' of sodium is used as an antacid in medicine. Name 'X' and write its chemical formula. What happens when it is heated strongly? Write the balanced chemical equation.
modelQA.answer:
1. Compound 'X' is Sodium Hydrogen Carbonate (or Sodium Bicarbonate), chemical formula: $NaHCO_3$.
2. When heated strongly, it decomposes into sodium carbonate, water, and carbon dioxide gas.
Balanced Equation:
$$2NaHCO_3(s) \xrightarrow{\Delta} Na_2CO_3(s) + H_2O(l) + CO_2(g)\uparrow$$
modelQA.rubric:
• Name and Formula: 1 Mark
• Explanation of heating: 1 Mark
• Balanced Chemical Equation: 1 Mark

modelQA.subject: Science
modelQA.question:
(a) What is the Chlor-alkali process? Why is it called so? (2M)
(b) Write balanced chemical equations for the process. (1M)
(c) Name the products formed at anode and cathode, and write one use of each. (2M)
modelQA.answer:
(a) When electricity is passed through an aqueous solution of sodium chloride (called brine), it decomposes to form sodium hydroxide. It is called the chlor-alkali process because of the products formed: 'chlor' for chlorine and 'alkali' for sodium hydroxide.

(b) Balanced Equation:
$$2NaCl(aq) + 2H_2O(l) \xrightarrow{\text{Electricity}} 2NaOH(aq) + Cl_2(g)\uparrow + H_2(g)\uparrow$$

(c) Products & Uses:
• At Anode: Chlorine gas ($Cl_2$). Use: Disinfectant for water, manufacturing PVC, bleaching powder.
• At Cathode: Hydrogen gas ($H_2$). Use: Fuel, margarine, ammonia for fertilisers.
• In Solution: Sodium hydroxide ($NaOH$). Use: De-greasing metals, soaps and detergents.
modelQA.rubric:
• Definition & Reason for name: 2 Marks
• Balanced chemical equation: 1 Mark
• Anode product & use: 1 Mark
• Cathode product & use: 1 Mark

modelQA.subject: Mathematics
modelQA.question: State and prove Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales Theorem).
modelQA.answer:
Statement:
If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle to intersect the other two sides in distinct points, then the other two sides are divided in the same ratio.

Given: $\triangle ABC$ where a line parallel to side $BC$ intersects $AB$ at $D$ and $AC$ at $E$.
To Prove: $\frac{AD}{DB} = \frac{AE}{EC}$.
Construction: Join $BE$ and $CD$. Draw $DM \perp AC$ and $EN \perp AB$.

Proof:
$\text{Area}(\triangle ADE) = \frac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height} = \frac{1}{2} \times AD \times EN$
$\text{Area}(\triangle BDE) = \frac{1}{2} \times DB \times EN$
$$\frac{\text{Area}(\triangle ADE)}{\text{Area}(\triangle BDE)} = \frac{\frac{1}{2} \times AD \times EN}{\frac{1}{2} \times DB \times EN} = \frac{AD}{DB} \quad \text{--- (1)}$$
Similarly, taking $AE$ as base with height $DM$:
$$\frac{\text{Area}(\triangle ADE)}{\text{Area}(\triangle CDE)} = \frac{\frac{1}{2} \times AE \times DM}{\frac{1}{2} \times EC \times DM} = \frac{AE}{EC} \quad \text{--- (2)}$$
Note that $\triangle BDE$ and $\triangle CDE$ are on the same base $DE$ and between the same parallels $BC$ and $DE$:
$$\text{Area}(\triangle BDE) = \text{Area}(\triangle CDE) \quad \text{--- (3)}$$
From (1), (2), and (3):
$$\frac{AD}{DB} = \frac{AE}{EC}$$
Hence proved!
modelQA.rubric:
• Accurate statement & Given/To Prove: 1 Mark
• Construction & labelled diagram: 1 Mark
• Ratio equations (1) and (2): 2 Marks
• Area equality between parallels & conclusion: 1 Mark

modelQA.subject: Mathematics
modelQA.question: Find a quadratic polynomial whose zeroes are $3 + \sqrt{5}$ and $3 - \sqrt{5}$.
modelQA.answer:
Let the zeroes be $\alpha = 3 + \sqrt{5}$ and $\beta = 3 - \sqrt{5}$.

1. Sum of zeroes:
$$\alpha + \beta = (3 + \sqrt{5}) + (3 - \sqrt{5}) = 6$$

2. Product of zeroes:
$$\alpha\beta = (3 + \sqrt{5})(3 - \sqrt{5}) = (3)^2 - (\sqrt{5})^2 = 9 - 5 = 4$$

3. General Quadratic Polynomial:
$$p(x) = k[x^2 - (\alpha + \beta)x + \alpha\beta]$$
For $k = 1$:
$$p(x) = x^2 - 6x + 4$$
modelQA.rubric:
• Sum of zeroes: 1 Mark
• Product of zeroes ($a^2 - b^2$ step): 1 Mark
• Final polynomial $x^2 - 6x + 4$: 1 Mark

modelQA.subject: Social Science
modelQA.question: Why is credit a crucial element in economic development? Mention any four reasons why formal sources of credit need to be expanded in India.
modelQA.answer:
Why Credit is Crucial:
Credit allows farmers to buy seeds and fertilisers, entrepreneurs to set up industries, and families to construct houses, creating employment and generating income.

Reasons to Expand Formal Sources of Credit:
1. Eliminate Exploitation: Informal lenders charge exorbitant interest rates (up to 36%-60% per year) which push borrowers into endless debt-traps.
2. Affordable Loans for Poor: Cheap and affordable credit through banks and cooperatives increases income and enables investment in profitable ventures.
3. RBI Supervision: The Reserve Bank of India ensures that banks give loans not just to profit-making businesses, but also to small cultivators, cottage industries, and small borrowers.
4. Equity & Inclusive Growth: Reducing dependence on informal moneylenders leads to balanced regional development and poverty reduction.
modelQA.rubric:
• Importance of credit in economy: 1 Mark
• 4 distinct valid reasons for formal sector expansion: 4 Marks (1 mark each)

modelQA.subject: Tamil
modelQA.question: வினா மற்றும் விடை எத்தனை வகைப்படும்? சான்றுகளுடன் வகைப்படுத்தி விளக்குக.
modelQA.answer:
I. வினா 6 வகைப்படும்:
1. அறிவினா: தான் விடை அறிந்திருந்தும் பிறரின் அறிவை அறியக் கேட்பது (எ.கா: 'இப்பாடலின் ஆசிரியர் யார்?' என ஆசிரியர் மாணவரிடம் கேட்பது).
2. அறியாவினா: தான் அறியாத ஒன்றை அறிந்து கொள்ளக் கேட்பது (எ.கா: 'இப்பாடலின் பொருள் யாது?' என மாணவர் ஆசிரியரிடம் கேட்பது).
3. ஐயவினா: தன் ஐயத்தைப் போக்கிக் கொள்ளக் கேட்பது (எ.கா: 'அங்கு கிடப்பது பாம்பா? கயிறா?').
4. கொளல்வினா: தான் ஒரு பொருளை வாங்கிக் கொள்ளும் பொருட்டுக் கேட்பது (எ.கா: 'பருப்பு உள்ளதா? என வணிகரிடம் கேட்பது).
5. கொடைவினா: இல்லாதவருக்கு கொடுக்கும் பொருட்டுக் கேட்பது (எ.கா: 'உன்னிடம் சீருடை இல்லையோ? என வழங்குவதற்காகக் கேட்பது).
6. ஏவல்வினா: ஒரு செயலைச் செய்யும்படி ஏவுவது (எ.கா: 'வீட்டில் தக்காளி இல்லை; கடைக்குச் செல்கிறாயா?').

II. விடை 8 வகைப்படும்:
சுட்டு விடை, நேர் விடை, எதிர்மறை விடை, ஏவல் விடை, வினாவெதிர் வினாதல் விடை, உற்றது உரைத்தல் விடை, உறுவது கூறல் விடை, இனமொழி விடை.

• விடை 8 வகைகள் தொகுப்பு: 2 மதிப்பெண்கள்
